name: Table
description: Data table with quiet hairlines, uppercase headers and hover rows. Styles plain table elements under .ayy-table.
whenToUse: Comparing items across the same attributes (projects × status × builds).
whenNotToUse: Layout — never use tables for layout.
Lists with one attribute — use a list.

classes.ayy-table-wrap: Scroll container around the table (horizontal overflow).
classes.ayy-table__num: On th/td with numbers: end-aligned, tabular digits.

js: tableClass({ compact?, className? }); tableWrapClass, tableNumClass constants

react.import: import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption } from "ayywi/react";

a11y: Use real <th> header cells with scope (React sets scope="col").
A <caption> or aria-label names the table for screen readers.
do: Keep cell content short; truncate with a tooltip if needed.
dont: Don't zebra-stripe; hairlines + hover are enough.
Don't nest interactive controls in every cell — one action column is plenty.
